  DF0   Lemmings               ^        | DF0                   
  DF1   * no disk *                     |                       
  DF2   not fitted (keypad + adds one)  | Floppy drive 0. Enter 
  DF3   not fitted (keypad + adds one)  | inserts a disk image  
  CD    * no disc *                     | (ADF) from the card,  
                                        | or ejects the disk in 
  Load configuration  Default           | the drive. Backspace  
  Save configuration  Default (exists)  | ejects every drive;   
                                        | keypad + and - add or 
  Reset                                 | remove drives (after  
  Reboot                                | a reset).
